第二天早上八点多，顾承安从酒店退了房。

走出酒店大门，顾承安从口袋里掏出那副智能眼镜戴上。

心里暗自吐槽了一下，这玩意儿好是真好，费电也是真费电。系统优化过一轮之后尚且如此，要搁优化之前，怕是充一晚上只能撑半天。

难怪智能眼镜到现在都没大面积铺开，光这个续航问题就劝退一大批人。普通消费者买回去，戴半天没电了，那跟买了个装饰品有什么区别？

不过对他来说，这东西不是装饰品，是一个好用的工具。

他一边想着一边走向自己的车，霸气的212安安静静地停在角落里。

顾承安拉开车门坐进去，发动引擎，一脚油门驶出酒店，往锦绣花园开去。

交通还算友好，没堵得太离谱。车子沿着北环大道一路往西北方向走，路过融侨中心那一片的时候，顾承安突然心里一动。

很多时候，电子支付虽然方便，但在某些特定场景下，现金才是硬通货。尤其是涉及到一些不方便留下电子痕迹的操作时，一沓红票子比什么都好使。

想到这儿，他方向盘一打，拐进了融玺中心。

这片区域商业配套齐全，他记得这里有一家建行的支行，规模不小。

车停在银行门口的临时车位上，顾承安熄火下车，锁好门，抬脚往建行大门走去。

刚走出去没多远，身后突然传来一个清脆的女声。

“顾——顾承安？”

他脚步一顿，回头一看。

一个穿着黑色职业套裙的年轻女人正站在不远处，手里拎着一杯咖啡，脸上带着惊讶又带着几分笑意。

沈悦。

就是之前跟苏楠一起吃饭时认识的那位，苏楠的闺蜜。当时苏楠还介绍说她是银行的来着。

今天的沈悦跟上次聚餐时完全不同，那天穿的是休闲装，今天换上职业装之后，整个人的气质都变了。

黑色包臀裙把身材的线条勾勒得恰到好处，头发盘起来，露出一截白净的脖颈，脚下踩着一双黑色细跟高跟鞋，走起路来带着一股干练劲儿。

顾承安停下脚步，冲她点了点头：“还真巧了，你该不会就在这儿上班吧？”

沈悦走过来，笑着说：“嘿，可不就是嘛，你来这边干嘛？”

“来银行办点事。”

沈悦上下打量了他一眼，目光在他身后那辆霸气的212上停了一下。

“行啊你，”沈悦挑了挑眉，“苏楠不是说你跑外卖的吗？开这么霸气一车？”

顾承安面不改色：“谁规定跑外卖的就不能开车了？说不定人家就是喜欢开着越野去送餐呢，客户体验感拉满。”

沈悦被逗乐了，摆了摆手：“开个玩笑，你别往心里去，有什么需要帮忙的吗？我在这儿上班，大忙帮不上，小事还是能说上话的。”

At around eight o'clock the next morning, Gu Chengan checked out of the hotel.

After walking out of the hotel door, Gu Chengan took out the pair of smart glasses from his pocket and put them on.

I secretly complained in my heart, this thing is really good, but it also wastes electricity.This is still the case after a round of system optimization. Before optimization, I am afraid that charging it overnight will only last half a day.

It’s no wonder that smart glasses haven’t been rolled out on a large scale until now. The battery life issue alone has dissuaded a large number of people.Ordinary consumers buy it and wear it for a long time before it runs out of power. What is the difference between buying it and buying it as a decoration?

But to him, this thing is not a decoration, but a useful tool.

As he thought about it, he walked towards his car. The domineering 212 parked quietly in the corner.

Gu Chengan opened the door and got in, started the engine, stepped on the accelerator and drove out of the hotel towards Splendid Garden.

The traffic is quite friendly and not too congested.The car walked northwest along Beihuan Avenue. When passing by the Rongqiao Center, Gu Chengan suddenly felt something in his heart.

Many times, although electronic payment is convenient, in some specific scenarios, cash is the hard currency.Especially when it comes to some operations that are inconvenient to leave electronic traces, a stack of red bills is better than anything else.

Thinking of this, he turned the steering wheel and turned into Rongxi Center.

This area has complete commercial facilities. He remembered that there was a branch of China Construction Bank here, which was quite large.

The car parked in a temporary parking space in front of the bank. Gu Chengan turned off the engine and got out, locked the door, and walked towards the CCB gate.

Not far after walking out, a clear female voice suddenly came from behind.

"Gu——Gu Chengan?"

He paused and looked back.

A young woman wearing a black professional skirt was standing not far away, holding a cup of coffee in her hand, with a look of surprise and a bit of a smile on her face.

Shen Yue.

It's the one I met when Su Nan had dinner with her before, Su Nan's best friend.At that time, Su Nan also introduced that she was from a bank.

Shen Yue today is completely different from the last time we had dinner. She was wearing casual clothes that day. After changing into professional clothes today, her whole temperament has changed.

The black butt-hugging skirt outlines the figure just right. Her hair is tied up, exposing a section of her fair neck. She wears a pair of black stiletto high heels, and she walks with a sense of competence.

Gu Chengan stopped and nodded to her: "What a coincidence. You don't work here, do you?"

Shen Yue came over and said with a smile: "Hey, that's right, what are you doing here?"

"Come to the bank to do something."

Shen Yue looked him up and down, and her eyes paused on the domineering 212 behind him.

"Okay, you," Shen Yue raised her eyebrows, "Didn't Su Nan say you are a takeaway business? Do you drive such a domineering car?"

Gu Chengan's expression remained unchanged: "Who said that people who run food delivery can't drive? Maybe they just like to drive cross-country to deliver food. It's a great customer experience."

Shen Yue was amused and waved her hand: "It's just a joke. Don't take it too seriously. Do you need any help? I work here. I can't help you with big things, but I can still talk about small things."
